summary: Per-tire contact force computation. Queries the track surface collision normal via CollisionNormalFromFeature, computes contact penetration depth, spring/damper normal force and slip velocity in the surface frame, applies a friction/load saturation, and writes the resulting tire force terms into the tire contact state. Called per-frame by WheelForceCalculationSpringDamperTorque (004E5470).

local_names.this: tire contact-state object (float array; offsets are byte displacements)
local_names.a2: contact/slip velocity vector for this tire
local_names.v17: collision normal X component (also reuse buffer)
local_names.v21: local contact position vector passed to the collision query
local_names.v26: stack double read before initialization (Hex-Rays artifact)

operations.description: Copy the tire contact position (this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8) into the local vector v21 used as input to the collision query.
Stash the collision-feature selector dword at this+0xE8 into local v27; after the query returns, the collision feature pointer is written back into this+0xE8.
Call CollisionNormalFromFeature(dbl_7C9360, contact position vector, &normal) to obtain the track surface normal and feature pointer.
Guard on the returned feature pointer: when non-null, penetration depth v16 = (this+0x4 - v26 - this+0xE4) * normal-Y; otherwise the normal defaults to (0, 1, 0) and v16 is set to 9.9999999e36.
Rotate the contact/slip velocity vector a2 into the surface frame using the collision normal basis, writing the result to this+0x38/+0x3C/+0x40.
Compute penetration depth v28 = this+0x90 - v16 and write it to this+0x74.
Guard on the penetration depth: when v28 >= 0 the contact branch computes tire forces; otherwise this+0x44 and this+0x34 are zeroed.
Project the rotated slip velocity onto the tire lateral basis: v7 = this+0x18 * this+0x38 + this+0x3C * this+0x1C + this+0x40 * this+0x20.
Saturation guard: when this+0x3C <= 0.98500001 and |v7| exceeds this+0x7C, v7 and this+0x74 are scaled by (2 * this+0x7C) / (|v7| + this+0x7C).
Spring/damper normal force: this+0x34 = this+0x78 * this+0x74 * this+0x3C.
Compute slip displacement relative to the wheel hub: this+0xCC/+0xD0/+0xD4 = (contact position minus normal-scaled penetration) minus hub vector a3, projected onto the surface frame.
Steep-normal branch: normal force this+0x34 = v28 * this+0x78, slip Y term = v28 + this+0x60 - this+0x90, and slip components taken from this+0xC and this+0x14 into this+0xCC/+0xD0.
Tire force result: this+0x44 = this+0xEC * this+0x74 - v7 * this+0xF0.
No-contact branch: force and normal-force terms this+0x44 and this+0x34 are cleared to zero.
Invoked per frame by WheelForceCalculationSpringDamperTorque (004E5470) as the tire-ground force stage.
